svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Organizational complexity mind map
svg.desc: Organizational complexity: Network connectivity strategies: AWS Global Infrastructure, AWS networking concepts, Hybrid DNS concepts; Security controls: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) and AWS IAM Identity Center, Route tables, security groups, and network ACLs, Encryption keys and certificate management; Reliable and resilient architectures: Recovery time objectives (RTOs) and recovery point objectives (RPOs), Disaster recovery strategies, Data backup and restoration; Multi-account environments: AWS Organizations and AWS Control Tower, Multi-account event notifications, AWS resource sharing across environments; Cost optimization and visibility: AWS cost and usage monitoring tools, AWS purchasing options, AWS rightsizing visibility tools
